Align reload checks with retained navigation

Reload recovery now checks the view the visitor selected: Plate after a failed mobile download, and Specimens after a theme change. The theme journey explicitly returns to Lanes before checking Corridor paint. Application behavior stays unchanged.

Closes #47. Follow-up to #46; coordinated in #26.

Both old assertions reproduced against the pre-packaging image. All seven affected reload/theme and related shareable-navigation journeys pass with this two-file repair. The preceding full population passed its other 120 cases and explicitly skipped three database-gated browser cases. Required CI and independent review are receiving this exact change. Reverting the test patch restores the prior expectations; navigation, theme and deployment source remain intact. Guide promotion stays held.

fix: shuffle answer choices for each quiz attempt # Summary Shuffle each question’s choices once per attempt, including retries. Keep the original choice index for grading and review. Number the choices before submission so the bank’s “A.” prefix cannot give away the answer; show the original letters after locking so the explanations still make sense. ## Type of change - [x] Website / component change - [x] Bug fix ## Anti-dump pledge - [x] No exam dumps, leaked questions, or NDA-violating material. No bank content changed. ## Verification - [x] `pnpm exec tsx --test website/tests/attempt.test.ts` — deterministic all-A and duplicate-text regressions - [x] `pnpm validate:bank` - [x] `pnpm build` - [x] `pnpm --filter website exec tsc --noEmit --types vite/client --lib ES2022,DOM,DOM.Iterable` (plain `tsc --noEmit` has the same Vite/ES library errors on main) ## Notes On a seeded, full-length attempt with each of the LPIC-1 and CISSP banks, selecting the first choice scored 21/100 instead of 100/100. No original option prefixes were visible in the unsubmitted answer text. ---

fix(cli): reject unsupported traces instead of simulating a sort ## Description For a Python file that sums `[3, 1, 2]`, the CLI used to report success and export ten bubble-sort steps. Remove the fallback so `trace` and `run` exit nonzero without exporting a snapshot or launching the viewer. Discard partial proxy traces on execution errors as well. - [x] Bug Fix - [x] Documentation / Tutorial Update The CLI help and quick starts now distinguish local tracing from the browser's Python support. This does not add a Python interpreter or change the existing C++ model. ## Verification & Testing - [x] `npm test -- --maxWorkers=2` (807 tests passed) - [x] `npm run build` Regression coverage exercises the Python sum with both commands, a JS error after an array write, and a supported JS program whose final array is intentionally unsorted. ---
